{{Top}}
[[File:Wuher-ANH.png||thumb|right|220px|[[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]], the bartender in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]].]]
A '''bartender''', also referred to as a '''pubtender''', '''mixer''' or '''mixicologist''', was an individual who served [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]], generally at a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] or [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]]. In a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] full of thousands of [[Species/Legends|species]] and countless types of drinks, it took intense training to tend a bar safely, as even common drinks could have adverse effects on certain species.

There was at least one [[MixRMastR|series of droid bartenders.]] Throughout the galaxy, bartenders were often looked to for advice by their patrons. Among the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], bartenders were often looked to for advice on spiritual matters, making bartenders more important than in most societies.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
